subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming Annual Charity Gala, which will be held on Friday, September 10th. This event is a great opportunity for us to come together, celebrate our achievements, and give back to the community. There will be a cocktail reception, dinner, auction, and live entertainment. Please RSVP by August 25th so we can finalize the guest list and seating arrangements. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Company Name]
